items.name: Sale of SmartDose 3.5mL manufacturing and supply rights to AbbVie
items.claim: West Pharmaceutical Services recorded charges related to its agreement to sell the SmartDose 3.5mL On-Body Delivery System and associated facilities to AbbVie.
items.source_excerpt: the Company's agreement to sell its SmartDose® 3.5mL On-Body Delivery System and associated facilities to AbbVie.

items.name: SmartDose 3.5mL sale and transfer to AbbVie completed
items.claim: West completed the sale and transfer of the manufacturing and supply rights for its SmartDose 3.5mL On-Body Delivery System and associated facilities to AbbVie; the transaction closed on July 1, 2026.
items.source_excerpt: today announced the company completed the sale and transfer of the manufacturing and supply rights for SmartDose® 3.5mL On-Body Delivery System and associated facilities. The transaction closed as planned on July 1, 2026.

notes: Both stored sources are West's own press releases (Q1 2026 8-K exhibit and the July 1, 2026 completion release) documenting the SmartDose 3.5mL divestiture to AbbVie, a named contract disclosed on West's own filing schedule.
